'''December 2000 Huntsville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Huntsville, AL in December 2000. [[Steven Lewis]] won it. It is known from Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1545">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-14-huntsville-al-closed-environmentd1545/ huntsville-al-closed-environment], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 14 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-14-huntsville-al-closed-environmentd1545/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' December 2000
* '''Site:''' Huntsville, AL
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steven Lewis]]
